shared_elements: figures carved in relief facing sideways
justification: Both surfaces show creatures rendered in profile, including a hooked bird beak/head, arranged with horizontal register or band divisions, which is about as generic a correspondence as figural relief can offer. The differences dominate: A shows two large anthropomorphic winged genies with elaborately feathered wings, garments, held staffs and finely modelled musculature, while B shows small, flat, silhouette-like animals (quadrupeds, birds) stacked in rows with no human figures, no wings on the bodies and no attributes, following utterly different conventions of proportion and infill.
